text:
Type: three-drawer chest of drawers
Use: storing clothes and linens; bedroom, living room
Style: contemporary, mid-century modern, glam
Materials: white lacquered wood with carved honeycomb relief fronts, brass-finish pulls and legs
Colors: white, warm gold
Shape: rectangular case, three wide drawers with textured hexagon pattern, curved recessed brass pulls, four slim tapered gold legs, raised and fairly light, medium size
Feel: bright, elegant, textured
Goes with: white or pale walls, brass accents, light wood; modern, glam or mid-century bedrooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Kingston Modern Chest of Drawers 35.43"W, White
product.description: The engineered geometric texture rendered in pure white puts this hardwood chest of drawers on the cusp of classic and modern. The gold accents on the drawer handles and feet add pops of color, and the three wide drawers provide plenty of space for storage. 35.43"W x 17.72"D x 29.53"H Engineered hardwood and fiberboard; metal legs Features textured detailing on front of drawers with gold accents on handles and feet. Two drawers for maximized storage next to couch or bed; side-mounted ball-bearing drawer slides and gold hand pulls. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty
